save_flows.longname: save cell-by-cell flows to budget file
save_flows.description: keyword to indicate that FMI flow terms will be written to the file specified with 'BUDGET FILEOUT' in Output Control.

flowtype.description: is the word GWFBUDGET, GWFHEAD, or GWFGRID.  If GWFBUDGET is specified, then the corresponding file must be a budget file.  If GWFHEAD is specified, the file must be a head file.  If GWFGRID is specified, the file must be a binary grid file.

fname.description: is the name of the file containing flows.  The path to the file should be included if the file is not located in the folder where the program was run.
